+		{Key: "tempauthscimv2"},

+			NameFirst:     "First",

+			Role:          "sitoo-store-staff",

+	_, err = scim.GetUser(ctx, 1, 1, created.Id)

+	created, err := scim.CreateUser(ctx, 1, 1, genmodel.ScimUser{

+	// decision 11; skip role priv + warehouse priv inserts in MySQL by

+		iamUser, ok := iamByUser[plainID]
+		if !ok {
+			// Strict Q9 filter: no IAM presence at site → user does not exist at site.
+			// (Production IAM returns source=legacy rows for legacy MySQL users via
+			// internal fallback; mock tests use SeedLegacy to simulate this.)
+			//
+			// Pagination note: totalAfterFilter starts at envelope.TotalResults (the
+			// account-wide MySQL count) and decrements for filtered-out users on
+			// the CURRENT page. SCIM totalResults is therefore approximate under
+			// rolesv2-on listing — strict per-page total would require two-phase
+			// fetching. Acceptable per spec; SCIM module is throw-away within
+			// ~12 months when SCIM moves into the IAM API.
+			totalAfterFilter--
+			continue
+		}
+		// Absent from the map → no priv rows at site → Active=true default.
+		// Map's zero value has Active=false which would be wrong; branch on ok.
+		st, ok := states[u.ID]
+		if !ok {
+			st = mysql.UserPrivState{Active: true}
+		}
+		u.Active = ptrtype.NewBool(st.Active)
+		u.PosRefundCard = ptrtype.NewBool(st.PosRefundCard)
+		u.PosAllStores = ptrtype.NewBool(st.PosAllStores)
+		scimUser := ToScimUser(u)
+		overrideRoleStoresFromIAM(&scimUser, iamUser)
+		scimUsers = append(scimUsers, scimUser)
+	}
+
+	return &genmodel.ScimUserEnvelope{
+		ItemsPerPage: &count,
+		StartIndex:   &startIndex,
+		TotalResults: &totalAfterFilter,
+		Schemas:      []genmodel.ScimListResponse{genmodel.SCIMLISTRESPONSE_URNIETFPARAMSSCIMAPIMESSAGES2_0LIST_RESPONSE},
+		Resources:    scimUsers,
+		Meta:         nil,
+	}, nil
+}

+// updateUserV2 is the V2 (IAM-aware) SCIM UpdateUser body. Parses the
+// patch, routes the role op by classifyRole, and ensures IAM-side state
+// reflects the PATCH outcome. Callers must already have decided to take
+// the V2 path.
+func (s Scim) updateUserV2(
+	c context.Context,
+	accountId int64,
+	siteId int64,
+	userId string,
+	userPatch genmodel.ScimUserPatch,
+	viewerEnabled bool,
+) (*genmodel.ScimUser, error) {
+	if userPatch.Operations == nil {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+
+	profileUpdate, rolePatch, storesPatch, err := parsePatch(viewerEnabled, userPatch)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	var iamWriteHappened bool
+
+	db, err := s.getDB(c, accountId)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	var newBucket roleBucket
+	var newSlug string
+	if rolePatch != nil {
+		newSlug = *rolePatch
+		newBucket = classifyRole(newSlug)
+	}
+
+	// When the role op routes to legacy, fold the role into the priv-key
+	// shape that mysql.UpdateUser expects.
+	if rolePatch != nil && newBucket == bucketLegacy {
+		switch newSlug {
+		case model.ROLE_ADMIN:
+			profileUpdate["roleAdmin"] = ptrtype.NewBool(true)
+		case model.ROLE_STAFF:
+			profileUpdate["roleStaff"] = ptrtype.NewBool(true)
+		case model.ROLE_STORE_MANAGER:
+			profileUpdate["roleStoreManager"] = ptrtype.NewBool(true)
+		case model.ROLE_STORE_STAFF:
+			profileUpdate["roleStoreStaff"] = ptrtype.NewBool(true)
+		case model.ROLE_VIEWER:
+			profileUpdate["roleViewer"] = ptrtype.NewBool(true)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Stores are always written to legacy MySQL when present, regardless of
+	// bucket: keeps warehouse privs in sync so flip-back between IAM and
+	// legacy buckets does not require a stores backfill. IAM-side writes
+	// (in the switch below) layer on top for IAM-bucket users. For
+	// IAM-only users with no MySQL priv anchor, mysql.UpdateUser 404s and
+	// the UpdateUserProfile fallback below skips stores silently — no
+	// legacy state to maintain in that case.
+	if storesPatch != nil {
+		profileUpdate["stores"] = *storesPatch
+	}
+
+	// Stores-only PATCH: probe IAM BEFORE the mysql write because the
+	// legacy update can clobber priv state that the IAM merge logic
+	// reads (e.g. warehouse priv counts feeding store inferences). The
+	// switch below consumes iamExisting for the stores-only IAM write
+	// path; capturing it here keeps the read deterministic regardless of
+	// mysql side effects. The legacy stores write happens unconditionally
+	// via the fold above.
+	var iamExisting *iam.Assignment
+	if storesPatch != nil && rolePatch == nil {
+		iamExisting, err = readIAMSiteAssignment(c, s.iamClient, accountId, siteId, userId)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, mapIAMErrorToSCIM(err)
+		}
+	}
+
+	updatedUser, err := mysql.UpdateUser(c, db, siteId, userId, profileUpdate)
+	if err != nil {
+		// IAM-bucket users with no priv anchor (Task 4 edge): mysql.UpdateUser
+		// returns 404 immediately because its getUserRow JOINs on the priv
+		// table. Fall back to a profile-only UPDATE that writes to
+		// sd_admin_users directly. Role/stores stay authoritative in IAM.
+		if errors.ExtractHTTPStatus(err) != http.StatusNotFound {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		updatedUser, err = mysql.UpdateUserProfile(c, db, userId, profileUpdate)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}
+
+	scimUser := ToScimUser(updatedUser)
+
+	// IAM-side writes
+	switch {
+	case rolePatch != nil && newBucket == bucketIAM:
+		existing, rErr := readIAMSiteAssignment(c, s.iamClient, accountId, siteId, userId)
+		if rErr != nil {
+			return nil, mapIAMErrorToSCIM(rErr)
+		}
+		stores, mergeErr := mergeStoresForRolePatch(existing, storesPatch)
+		if mergeErr != nil {
+			return nil, model.NewScimError(http.StatusBadRequest, genmodel.ScimErrorObject{
+				Detail: mergeErr.Error(), Status: "400", ScimType: "invalidSyntax",
+				Schemas: []genmodel.ScimError{genmodel.SCIMERROR_URNIETFPARAMSSCIMAPIMESSAGES2_0ERROR},
+			})
+		}
+		if err := upsertIAMSiteAssignment(c, s.iamClient, accountId, siteId, userId, newSlug, stores); err != nil {
+			return nil, mapIAMErrorToSCIM(err)
+		}
+		iamWriteHappened = true
+		scimUser.UrnietfparamsscimschemasextensionSitoo20User.Role = newSlug
+		joinedStores := storeIDsToString(stores)
+		scimUser.UrnietfparamsscimschemasextensionSitoo20User.Stores = &joinedStores
+
+	case storesPatch != nil && rolePatch == nil && iamExisting != nil:
+		storeIDs, parseErr := storesToIDs(storesPatch.Stores)
+		if parseErr != nil {
+			return nil, model.NewScimError(http.StatusBadRequest, genmodel.ScimErrorObject{
+				Detail: parseErr.Error(), Status: "400", ScimType: "invalidSyntax",
+				Schemas: []genmodel.ScimError{genmodel.SCIMERROR_URNIETFPARAMSSCIMAPIMESSAGES2_0ERROR},
+			})
+		}
+		stores := applyStoresOp(iamExisting.StoreIDs, storeIDs, storesPatch.Operation)
+		if err := upsertIAMSiteAssignment(c, s.iamClient, accountId, siteId, userId, iamExisting.RoleSlug, stores); err != nil {
+			return nil, mapIAMErrorToSCIM(err)
+		}
+		iamWriteHappened = true
+		scimUser.UrnietfparamsscimschemasextensionSitoo20User.Role = iamExisting.RoleSlug
+		joinedStores := storeIDsToString(stores)
+		scimUser.UrnietfparamsscimschemasextensionSitoo20User.Stores = &joinedStores
+	}
+
+	// Read-side response override: when V2 is on and the PATCH did not
+	// modify IAM, the response must still reflect IAM-side truth for
+	// users already living in IAM from prior writes.
+	if !iamWriteHappened {
+		// iamExisting is already known when a stores-only PATCH probed IAM
+		// and found nothing; only fetch when we have no cached value.
+		current := iamExisting
+		if current == nil && storesPatch == nil {
+			current, err = readIAMSiteAssignment(c, s.iamClient, accountId, siteId, userId)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, mapIAMErrorToSCIM(err)
+			}
+		}
+		if current != nil {
+			overrideRoleStoresFromIAM(&scimUser, current)
+		}
+	}
+
+	return &scimUser, nil
+}

+// deleteUserV2 is the V2 (IAM-aware) SCIM DeleteUser body. Clears the
+// site's MySQL priv rows (best-effort), removes any IAM-side assignment
+// at the site, and only deletes the MySQL user row when no priv rows nor
+// any IAM assignment remain account-wide. Callers must already have
+// decided to take the V2 path.
+func (s Scim) deleteUserV2(
+	c context.Context,
+	accountId int64,
+	siteId int64,
+	userId string,
+) error {
+	db, err := s.getDB(c, accountId)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	// 1. clear MySQL site privs (no row delete). NotFound means no rows existed
+	// at THIS site (e.g. IAM-only user or legacy user with privs only at other
+	// sites). The returned remainingPrivs is still the authoritative account-wide
+	// priv count and may be > 0 when the user holds privs at other sites.
+	remainingPrivs, mErr := mysql.DeleteUserPrivsAtSite(c, db, siteId, userId)
+	if mErr != nil {
+		if mapped := mapMysqlDeleteUserError(c, s, mErr, accountId, siteId, userId); mapped != nil {
+			return mapped
+		}
+		// NotFound + IAM-only user at site: legitimate no-op; remainingPrivs is
+		// still the authoritative account-wide count — do not override it.
+	}
+
+	// 2. delete IAM site assignment via PUT with empty slug. Always called
+	// regardless of the per-account V2 flag: writes route by role
+	// bucket, not the flag, so a delete must clear any IAM-side residue
+	// that prior writes could have left (and remain deterministic across
+	// enable→disable→enable flips). No-op when no assignment exists for
+	// the (account, site, user) tuple.
+	if err := deleteIAMSiteAssignment(c, s.iamClient, accountId, siteId, userId); err != nil {
+		return mapIAMErrorToSCIM(err)
+	}
+
+	// 3. IAM account-wide presence check. Step 2 already cleared this
+	// site's assignment, so any remaining hits are at other sites — the
+	// check does not pass a site filter.
+	anyIAM, err := hasAnyIAMAccountAssignments(c, s.iamClient, accountId, userId)
+	if err != nil {
+		return mapIAMErrorToSCIM(err)
+	}
+
+	// 4. row delete only when both buckets are account-empty.
+	if remainingPrivs == 0 && !anyIAM {
+		if err := mysql.DeleteUserRow(c, db, userId); err != nil {
+			log.MustGetFromContext(c).LogError(
+				log.Entry("tempauthscimv2 user-row delete failed").
+					String("tag", "tempauthscimv2_dual_state").
+					String("account_id", strconv.FormatInt(accountId, 10)).
+					String("site_id", strconv.FormatInt(siteId, 10)).
+					String("user_id", userId).
+					Error("error", err),
+			)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+// SCIM response. Returns nil when the caller should treat the error as a
+// legitimate no-op (NotFound + IAM-only user at site). Returns a SCIM error
+// otherwise: 400 for invalid input, 404 when neither MySQL nor IAM has the
+// user at this site, 500 for everything else.
+func mapMysqlDeleteUserError(
+	c context.Context,
+	s Scim,
+	err error,
+	accountId, siteId int64,
+	userId string,
+) error {
+	status := errors.ExtractHTTPStatus(err)
+	switch status {
+	case http.StatusBadRequest:
+		return model.NewScimError(http.StatusBadRequest, genmodel.ScimErrorObject{
+			Detail: "Invalid data", Status: "400", ScimType: "invalidSyntax",
+			Schemas: []genmodel.ScimError{genmodel.SCIMERROR_URNIETFPARAMSSCIMAPIMESSAGES2_0ERROR},
+		})
+	case http.StatusNotFound:
+		// Probe IAM: if user has no assignment at this site, the user truly
+		// does not exist at (account, site). If IAM has an assignment, treat
+		// the MySQL NotFound as a legitimate no-op for an IAM-only user.
+		assignment, probeErr := readIAMSiteAssignment(c, s.iamClient, accountId, siteId, userId)
+		if probeErr != nil {
+			log.MustGetFromContext(c).LogError(
+				log.Entry("post-mysql-notfound iam probe failed").Error("error", probeErr))
+			return model.NewScimError(http.StatusInternalServerError, genmodel.ScimErrorObject{
+				Detail: "Internal server error", Status: "500", ScimType: "invalidSyntax",
+				Schemas: []genmodel.ScimError{genmodel.SCIMERROR_URNIETFPARAMSSCIMAPIMESSAGES2_0ERROR},
+			})
+		}
+		if assignment == nil {
+			return scimNotFound("User not found")
+		}
+		return nil
+	default:
+		log.MustGetFromContext(c).LogError(log.Entry("mysql site-priv delete failed").Error("error", err))
+		return model.NewScimError(http.StatusInternalServerError, genmodel.ScimErrorObject{
+			Detail: "Error connecting to DB", Status: "500", ScimType: "invalidSyntax",
+			Schemas: []genmodel.ScimError{genmodel.SCIMERROR_URNIETFPARAMSSCIMAPIMESSAGES2_0ERROR},
+		})
+	}
+}

+// Detail:  generic per-status string. The IAM response body is NOT
+//
+//	surfaced — it may contain internal identifiers — but stays in
+//	the internal err so logIAMError records it at the call site.
+func mapIAMErrorToSCIM(err error) error {
+	status := errors.ExtractHTTPStatus(err)
+	if status == 0 {
+		status = http.StatusInternalServerError
+	}
+	var detail string
+	switch status {
+	case http.StatusBadRequest:
+		detail = "Invalid request"
+	case http.StatusUnauthorized:
+		detail = "Unauthorized"
+	case http.StatusForbidden:
+		detail = "Forbidden"
+	case http.StatusNotFound:
+		detail = "Not found"
+	case http.StatusConflict:
+		detail = "Conflict"
+	default:
+		detail = "Internal server error"
+	}
+	return model.NewScimError(status, genmodel.ScimErrorObject{
+		Detail: detail, Status: strconv.Itoa(status), ScimType: "invalidSyntax",
+		Schemas: []genmodel.ScimError{genmodel.SCIMERROR_URNIETFPARAMSSCIMAPIMESSAGES2_0ERROR},

+// parsePatch translates a SCIM PATCH envelope into a normalised triple:
+//   - profileUpdate: keys understood by mysql.UpdateUser (email, active, etc.).
+//     Role priv keys (roleAdmin/roleStaff/...) are NOT filled in here. The
+//     caller decides whether to fold the role slug into profileUpdate based
+//     on classifyRole.
+//   - iamRolePatch: the new role slug if a role op was present, else nil.
+//   - iamStoresPatch: the stores op (add/remove/replace) if present, else nil.
+//     Stores ops are NOT folded into profileUpdate here; the caller decides
+//     whether to forward them to mysql.UpdateUser (legacy bucket) or to a
+//     upsertIAMSiteAssignment call (IAM bucket).
+//
+// Validation:
+//   - role == "viewer" requires the tempviewerrole config gate
+//     (per pre-branch behaviour). sitoo-viewer is NOT gated.
+//   - role op with missing string value is ignored (matches current behaviour).
+//
+// viewerEnabled mirrors the per-account `tempviewerrole` gate. When a
+// viewer role op is present and the flag is false, parsePatch rejects
+// with a 404 (matches the legacy behaviour of viewerRoleFeatureFlag).
+func parsePatch(
+	viewerEnabled bool,
+	userPatch genmodel.ScimUserPatch,
+) (map[string]any, *string, *model.StoresOp, error) {
+	profileUpdate := make(map[string]any)
+	var rolePatch *string
+	var storesPatch *model.StoresOp
+
+	for _, op := range userPatch.Operations {
+		if op.Op == nil {
+			return nil, nil, nil, errors.New(errors.CodeInvalidInput, "Invalid patch, missing operation")
+		}
+		if op.Path == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		p := *op.Path
+		switch p {
+		case "externalID", "externalId":
+			profileUpdate["scimexternalid"], _ = op.GetValue().GetValuestringOK()
+		case "email", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:email":
+			profileUpdate["email"], _ = op.GetValue().GetValuestringOK()
+		case "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:externalID":
+			profileUpdate["externalID"], _ = op.GetValue().GetValuestringOK()
+		case "userName", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:userName":
+			profileUpdate["userName"], _ = op.GetValue().GetValuestringOK()
+		case "nameFirst", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:nameFirst":
+			profileUpdate["nameFirst"], _ = op.GetValue().GetValuestringOK()
+		case "nameLast", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:nameLast":
+			profileUpdate["nameLast"], _ = op.GetValue().GetValuestringOK()
+		case "role", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:role":
+			v, ok := op.GetValue().GetValuestringOK()
+			if !ok {
+				continue
+			}
+			if *v == model.ROLE_VIEWER && !viewerEnabled {
+				return nil, nil, nil, scimNotFound("Viewer role not allowed")
+			}
+			role := *v
+			rolePatch = &role
+		case "posRefundCard", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:posRefundCard":
+			v, err := scimPatchOpsToBool(op)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			profileUpdate["posRefundCard"] = &v
+		case "posAllStores", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:posAllStores":
+			v, err := scimPatchOpsToBool(op)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			profileUpdate["posAllStores"] = &v
+		case "stores", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:stores":
+			stores, _ := scimPatchOpsToStrings(op)
+			storesOp := model.StoresOp{Stores: stores}
+			switch strings.ToLower(*op.Op) {
+			case "add":
+				storesOp.Operation = model.OperationAdd
+			case "remove":
+				storesOp.Operation = model.OperationRemove
+			case "replace":
+				storesOp.Operation = model.OperationReplace
+			default:
+				continue
+			}
+			storesPatch = &storesOp
+		case "active", "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Sitoo:2.0:User:active":
+			v, err := scimPatchOpsToBool(op)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			profileUpdate["active"] = &v
+		}
+	}
+	return profileUpdate, rolePatch, storesPatch, nil
+}

+// mergeUnique returns the union of a and b preserving order; duplicates
+// from b after a are dropped.
+func mergeUnique(a, b []int64) []int64 {
+	seen := make(map[int64]struct{}, len(a)+len(b))
+	out := make([]int64, 0, len(a)+len(b))
+	for _, v := range a {
+		if _, ok := seen[v]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[v] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, v)
+	}
+	for _, v := range b {
+		if _, ok := seen[v]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[v] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, v)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+// subtract returns a with elements of drop removed, preserving order.
+func subtract(a, drop []int64) []int64 {
+	if len(drop) == 0 {
+		return a
+	}
+	rm := make(map[int64]struct{}, len(drop))
+	for _, v := range drop {
+		rm[v] = struct{}{}
+	}
+	out := make([]int64, 0, len(a))
+	for _, v := range a {
+		if _, ok := rm[v]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		out = append(out, v)
+	}
+	return out
+}

+// mergeStoresForRolePatch carries existing IAM stores forward when a role
+// PATCH omits the stores field. When storesPatch is present, applies it on
+// top of existing stores.
+func mergeStoresForRolePatch(existing *iam.Assignment, storesPatch *model.StoresOp) ([]int64, error) {
+	var base []int64
+	if existing != nil {
+		base = slices.Clone(existing.StoreIDs)
+	}
+	if storesPatch == nil {
+		return base, nil
+	}
+	storeIDs, err := storesToIDs(storesPatch.Stores)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return applyStoresOp(base, storeIDs, storesPatch.Operation), nil
+}

+// applyStoresOp returns the new stores slice after applying a PATCH op
+// (add/remove/replace) on a base set.
+func applyStoresOp(base, delta []int64, op model.Operation) []int64 {
+	switch op {
